title: What should consume entitlement
question: Should anything besides creating a visual project consume entitlement, for example captures, processing runs or progress usage? Should a visual project's credit be returned if it ends early?
context: Today nothing is metered: the only split is the project's intent (BILL-REQ-022). In the credit model, credit is consumed once, by a visual project's size (BILL-REQ-006), and never returned (BILL-REQ-003). No capture, processing or progress code checks credit.
options: Return credit when a visual project ends early
